comment: OMR engine configuration. Auto-detected values can be overridden here.

engine.comment_mode: auto: use both if available | audiveris-only | smt-only

inference.comment_provider: auto: DirectML(Win GPU) > CPU | dml | cpu
inference.comment_threads: 0 = auto (use all cores), or set specific number

smt.comment_maxTokens: Maximum decoder output length. Lower = faster. 500 is enough for most hymns.
